title: Discrepancy
description: A typed, sourced trigger for a generated hypothesis: a measured value that satisfies no live hypothesis band (anomaly), model arms that disagree on one observable (model_disagreement), or a declared coverage dimension no study probes (coverage_gap). Derived from the cycle bundle's signals; it carries the measured surprise a `hypothesize` act must explain, so a generated alternative is tied to evidence, not a prompt. It asserts no mechanism. Strict at the top level: unknown fields are errors.

id.description: Content-addressed `dc:<sha1[:12]>` on (study, observable, kind), so the same surprise re-derives the same id.

source_evidence_ref.description: Immutable reference to the measured evidence that raised this (e.g. `study#observable`, a run id, or a finding id). A discrepancy always names where its surprise came from.

observed.description: The measured value that satisfied none of the live hypothesis bands (anomaly kind).

live_bands.description: The live hypotheses' predicted bands for the observable, if carried.

arms.description: arm -> value, for a model_disagreement (never averaged).
